name: Denmark
note: Danish national law: Arveloven, Lov om fremtidsfuldmagter, Værgemålsloven, Dødsboskifteloven and Sundhedsloven. retsinformation.dk serves these only as a JavaScript application, so each act was read by rendering the official page; the acts are cited as passed, and each page also lists the consolidating LBK versions.

citations.title: Slægtninges arveret
citations.quote: En arveladers nærmeste slægtsarvinger er dennes børn. Børnene arver lige.

citations.cite: Lov om fremtidsfuldmagter (lov nr. 618 af 8. juni 2016) § 1
citations.title: Oprettelse af fremtidsfuldmagt
citations.quote: Den, der er fyldt 18 år ... kan oprette en fremtidsfuldmagt til at træde i kraft, hvis den pågældende på et senere tidspunkt ... ikke længere har evne til at varetage sine forhold

citations.title: Gyldighedskrav
citations.quote: En fremtidsfuldmagt skal for at være gyldig oprettes skriftligt i Fremtidsfuldmagtsregisteret ved anvendelse af den digitale løsning ... og vedkendes for en notar

citations.title: Fremtidsfuldmagtens ikraftsættelse
citations.quote: En anmodning om at sætte en fremtidsfuldmagt i kraft indgives til Statsforvaltningen af fuldmagtsgiveren eller af fremtidsfuldmægtigene i forening.

citations.title: Værgemål for voksne
citations.quote: Der kan iværksættes værgemål for den, der på grund af sindssygdom ... eller anden form for alvorligt svækket helbred er ude af stand til at varetage sine anliggender

citations.title: Patienter der varigt mangler evnen til at give informeret samtykke
citations.quote: For en patient, der varigt mangler evnen til at give informeret samtykke, kan de nærmeste pårørende give informeret samtykke til behandling.

citations.title: Udtagelse af væv fra afdøde
citations.quote: Indgrebet må foretages, såfremt afdøde efter sit fyldte 18. år skriftligt har truffet bestemmelse herom.

citations.title: Privat skifte
citations.quote: Et bo udleveres til privat skifte, såfremt 1) alle arvinger anmoder derom, 2) boets aktiver ... må antages at være tilstrækkelige til at dække boets gæld

citations.title: Behandling ved bobestyrer
citations.quote: Skifteretten udleverer et bo til behandling ved bobestyrer, såfremt 1) en arving anmoder derom, 2) boet må antages at være insolvent ... 4) afdøde har bestemt dette i testamente

roles.name: Fremtidsfuldmægtig
roles.summary: A future power of attorney. Denmark gates it at both ends: it is only valid if created in the national register and acknowledged before a notary, and it has no effect until the authority puts it into force on request.

assigned.event: Person aged 18 and able to act sensibly creates a fremtidsfuldmagt

starts.event: Only when the authority puts it into force on a request by the grantor or the attorneys jointly

ends.event: Death of the grantor; the estate passes to the arvinger

transitions.event: Oprettes i Fremtidsfuldmagtsregisteret og vedkendes for en notar (§ 3)
conditions: i stand til at handle fornuftsmæssigt

nameEn.en: Attorney under a future power of attorney

fremtidsfuldmægtig.en: attorney under a future power of attorney

roles.name: Værge
roles.summary: Guardianship may be established for an adult who, through mental illness including severe dementia, impaired development or other seriously weakened health, cannot manage their own affairs, and only where there is a need.

assigned.event: Værgemål established for an adult unable to manage their affairs

conditions: hvis der er behov for det

citation.title: Guardianship – The Agency of Family Law
citation.quote: Persons to be placed under guardianship cannot choose their own guardian, but their wishes are taken into account.

citation.title: Guardianship – The Agency of Family Law
citation.quote: Persons to be placed under guardianship cannot choose their own guardian, but their wishes are taken into account.

citation.title: Guardianship – The Agency of Family Law
citation.quote: Persons to be placed under guardianship cannot choose their own guardian, but their wishes are taken into account.

roles.name: Nærmeste pårørende
roles.summary: Where a patient permanently lacks the ability to give informed consent, the nearest relatives may consent to treatment; if a guardianship covers personal matters, the guardian consents instead.

assigned.event: By status as nearest relative, or by a guardianship covering personal matters

starts.event: When the patient permanently lacks the ability to consent

transitions.event: Patienten mangler varigt evnen til at samtykke (§ 18)
Værgemål omfatter personlige forhold; værgen samtykker

roles.name: Arving
roles.summary: The nearest heirs are the children, sharing equally. Where the heirs all ask and the estate can cover its debts, the estate is released to them for private administration.

assigned.event: By the statutory order of succession or by will

ends.event: Estate released to a bobestyrer instead, or administration completed

transitions.event: Boet udleveres i stedet til bobestyrer (§ 36)

roles.name: Bobestyrer
roles.summary: The probate court releases the estate to an authorised administrator where an heir asks, the estate looks insolvent, the heirs cannot act, or the heirs are unknown.

assigned.event: Skifteretten releases the estate to a bobestyrer

citation.cite: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark, Inheritance (English page)
citation.title: Inheritance – Administration of estates abroad
citation.quote: a Danish probate court has only jurisdiction to administer the estate of a deceased person provided the deceased was a resident in Denmark

roles.name: Bobestyrer indsat ved testamente
roles.summary: Denmark's nearest equivalent to an executor: the deceased may direct in a will that the estate be administered by a bobestyrer, which is one of the grounds for release.

assigned.event: The deceased so directed by will

starts.event: On the court releasing the estate on that ground

transitions.event: Afdøde har bestemt dette i testamente (§ 36, nr. 4)

roles.name: Afdødes egen bestemmelse om vævsudtagelse
roles.summary: Denmark requires the donor's own decision: tissue may be taken where the deceased, after turning 18, decided so in writing, and relatives cannot override a written decision.

assigned.event: The deceased's own written determination made after turning 18

starts.event: After death at a hospital or similar institution

transitions.event: Afdøde har efter sit fyldte 18. år skriftligt truffet bestemmelse (§ 53, stk. 2)
Dødsfald; pårørende kan ikke modsætte sig en skriftlig bestemmelse

nameEn.en: The deceased's own decision on tissue removal

poaDurableByDefault.note: A fremtidsfuldmagt is created precisely to take effect if the grantor later cannot manage their affairs.

poaRegistrationBeforeUse.note: Valid only if created in the Fremtidsfuldmagtsregister and acknowledged before a notary, and it has no effect until the authority puts it into force on request.

healthAgentStartsOn.note: The nearest relatives may consent once the patient permanently lacks the ability to give informed consent.

organDonationModel.name: Sundhedsloven § 53
organDonationModel.note: Removal rests on the deceased's own written decision made after turning 18; relatives cannot override a written decision.

digitalAssetsFiduciaryStatute.note: No dedicated digital-asset statute; digital assets sit in the bo, administered either privately by the arvinger or by a bobestyrer.

probateGrantName.note: The skifteret releases the estate, either to the heirs for privat skifte or to a bobestyrer; there is no grant in the common-law sense.
